item: AMENDMENT_QUEUE Tier-1 #15 - independent GEO bulk validation of rankscore panel
locked_before: any probe-level analysis; only series metadata (titles, platforms, sample counts) inspected
primary_endpoint: per-antigen tumor-vs-normal enrichment: median tumor > median normal, one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.05 after BH across the 7 tests; PASS if >= 6/7 antigens enrich in their expected indication
secondary_endpoint: Spearman between external tumor-expression ranking (per-antigen median tumor expression in its home cohort, probes collapsed to max-median probe per gene) and rankscore tumor_signal component ordering; reported as measured, no threshold
honesty: probe->symbol mapping via each platform's GEO annotation file; multi-probe genes collapsed by max-median probe BEFORE any tumor/normal comparison; failures reported per antigen, not dropped
not_in_scope: validates tumor-signal direction only; cannot validate safety/tractability components
